---
title: "5 · Cases"
---

The firm, school, and county cases show how grades depend on the outcomes and the reports under consideration.
The firm case compares [KRW's and postrank's loss scales](lambda-tau.qmd), examines the
[archived cards](krw-card.qmd), and compares [signed and absolute contact gaps](signed-or-absolute.qmd) and
[common grades for race and gender](krw-two.qmd). For the twelve schools, compare
[grade boundaries](cde-cuts.qmd) and [reports at matched disclosure](cde-one-disclosure.qmd), then examine
[why a likely direction is withheld](cde-pair.qmd) or how [reports change with the cost of withholding](cde-tau-path.qmd).
The [Alabama county case](alabama-map.qmd) maps grades for historical income and incarceration and shows
the added risk of using one report for both outcomes.

The [forty fictional sites](../profiles/fictional-site-profiles.qmd) illustrate what separate grades can report.
The browser counts comparisons from the saved grades and displays the risk and joint-event summaries from the original analysis.
